args.summary: Acme has 12 active findings across 7 devices: 3 batteries at end-of-life (Service Recommended), 2 devices with critically low storage (<3% free), 1 device with prohibited software (uTorrent), 5 devices with screen_lock compliance drift (failing for 12-22 consecutive days), and 1 device with persistent high RAM usage (95%+ on 16 GB).

claims.text: Three devices have batteries in 'Service Recommended' condition: acme-macbook-1 (cycle count 1049, since 2026-05-30), acme-thinkpad-8 (cycle count 1157, since 2026-05-23), and acme-dell-9 (cycle count 948, since 2026-05-24).

Two devices have critically low system volume free space: acme-thinkpad-8 at 2.6% free (26 GB of 1024 GB, low in 25 of 30 snapshots, trend -0.51%/day) and acme-macbook-4 at 2.0% free (10 GB of 512 GB, low in 30 of 30 snapshots, trend -0.20%/day).
acme-macbook-2 has prohibited software uTorrent 3.6 installed, first seen 2026-05-31.

Five devices show screen_lock compliance drift (medium severity): acme-macbook-2 failing since 2026-05-22 (22 consecutive fails), acme-thinkpad-8 since 2026-05-30 (14 fails), acme-mac-5 since 2026-06-01 (12 fails), acme-macbook-3 since 2026-06-01 (12 fails), and acme-macbook-4 since 2026-05-28 (16 fails).
acme-dell-9 shows persistent RAM constraint: RAM at or above 95% in 15 of 30 snapshots on a 16 GB device.

caveats: RAM constrained finding based on one reading per day; high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
Storage trend estimates are linear fits; actual depletion may vary.
